description: Configure Git to use different commit identities based on directory. Create two include files: 1) ~/.config/git/personal-identity.inc with [user] section containing a personal email (e.g., personal@example.com), 2) ~/.config/git/company-identity.inc with [user] section containing a company email (e.g., yourname@company.com) - the emails MUST be different. Then add conditional includes to ~/.gitconfig: [includeIf "gitdir:~/workspace/personal-projects/"] with path = ~/.config/git/personal-identity.inc, and [includeIf "gitdir:~/workspace/company-work/"] with path = ~/.config/git/company-identity.inc. The workspace has two subdirectories: personal-projects/ and company-work/, each containing git repositories that should use their respective identities.
